basic_info.description: $50K price reduction!    Welcome to The Potrero, a stunning split 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offering breathtaking northeast city views, a serene courtyard-facing layout, and the perfect blend of urban convenience and tranquility.     This light-filled home features two spacious en-suite bedroomsincluding a versatile second bedroom with a Murphy queen bed, built-in desk, and ample storagealong with a modern kitchen boasting a gas range, deep pantry, and abundant cabinet space.     Enjoy the ease of in-unit laundry, generous storage throughout, and exclusive South Tower amenities like an on-site gym and assigned parking.     Ideally situated above Whole Foods, this residence places you just steps from Potrero Hill's vibrant 18th Street dining and shopping scene, with effortless access to highways 101, 80, 280, the Bay Bridge, Caltrain, and BART. Whether you crave relaxation in your peaceful retreat or the energy of city living, this is your opportunity to own a rare, well-designed space in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
